styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and info screens, warm wood-tone surface #C89B66 for detail and closing shots, light neutral #F4F1EC for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, front-left key with fill, gentle soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm wood-tone tabletop #C89B66 and matte light neutral board #F4F1EC
styleLock.typography: modern rounded sans-serif headlines and labels only, charcoal #3A3F45 text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line playful icons only, single accent color #5BC8DC
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hanger angle for the garment across the set, consistent garment scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids summer fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm wood tone #C89B66, sky-aqua accent #5BC8DC and charcoal text #3A3F45; bright soft warm lighting with a front-left key and gentle soft shadows; modern rounded sans-serif headlines and labels only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line playful icon style; clean kids apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规，完整展示版型

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with fill, soft contact shadow

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the garment neatly arranged with sleeves laid naturally, full garment visible and not clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front key and fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the fabric. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered with even clean margins of the white field all around it. 8K, commercial kids apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hanger, no hands, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.
